item.title: Learning from mistakes with critique-guided distillation
item.description: Teacher feedback can supervise refinement during training while the deployed student answers from the prompt alone. A visual guide to CGD and its evaluation limits.

item.title: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) and Sensitivity Analysis: Part I
item.description: Uncertainty quantification asks how uncertain a prediction is, while sensitivity analysis identifies which uncertain inputs contribute most to that result.

item.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML): Application to Additive Manufacturing
item.description: Physics-informed machine learning can make limited experimental data more useful by adding physical constraints, simulation outputs, or simulation-based pretraining.

item.title: Multi-objective Optimization Under Uncertainty
item.description: Real design problems balance conflicting goals, and the best deterministic trade-off may be fragile once input and model uncertainty are included.
